entities.summary: Haidar Haidar was a Syrian writer and novelist. He acquired a wide reputation for his critical attitude towards political and religious institutions and his willingness to cover controversial topics in a rational way. He published seventeen books of fiction, short stories, essays and biography, including The Desolate Time, which was chosen by the Arab Writers Union as one of the best 105 books of the 20th century.
